latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of backtest-poller.

- Monitors QuantConnect backtests in the background with adaptive polling.
- Tracks real-time equity, draws down early-stop, auto-downloads results, and runs automated diagnosis.
- Persists state to a file with locking for reliability and survives terminal disconnection.
- Provides CLI commands for submission, status, logs, poller control, and results.
- Sends system notifications on macOS when backtests complete.
